no_start.label: No start
no_start.description: The engine does not start, or starts only with difficulty

brakes.label: Brakes
brakes.description: Brake noise, a soft pedal, or the car pulls when it brakes

flat_battery.label: Flat battery
flat_battery.description: The battery has too little charge to turn the starter

starter_motor.label: Starter motor failure
starter_motor.description: The starter motor or its solenoid does not turn the engine

worn_pads.label: Worn brake pads
worn_pads.description: The pad material is at or below the wear limit

warped_discs.label: Warped discs
warped_discs.description: The brake discs have run-out and cause a pulse in the pedal

q_key_turn.question: What happens when the driver turns the key to start?

click_only.text: One click or rapid clicks, the engine does not turn

q_headlights_dim.question: Do the headlights go dim when the key turns to start?

q_brake_noise.question: What noise do the brakes make?

squeal.text: A high squeal or a metal grind

none.text: No noise, but the pedal pulses
